result_rules: A result file must contain exactly one result entry per language in compliance/alpha_v1_languages.json order.
Use result=verified only when the smoke check executed successfully in the current environment.
Use result=skipped only when the required runtime or toolchain is missing or intentionally unavailable.
Use result=failed when the smoke check exists but returns a failing status or raises an unexpected error.
Skipped entries must include a reason explaining the missing runtime/toolchain gate.
Failed entries must include a reason sufficient for CI triage.
Result files are environment evidence and must not be used to remove the requirement for CI-friendly smoke scripts.
